question: In which year has the Government of India instituted Arjuna Award to recognise outstanding achievement in national sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Award **was instituted by the Government of India in the year **1961**.
 
• This award is given to recognize **outstanding achievements in national sports events**.
 
• It is one of the highest honors bestowed upon sports persons in India.
 
• The award includes a bronze statue of Arjuna, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
• Over the years, the criteria and categories for the award have evolved to include more sports disciplines and achievements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The award aims to encourage young athletes to excel in their respective sports and bring laurels to the country.
 
• It was named after Arjuna, a central character in the Indian epic Mahabharata, symbolizing hard work, dedication, and excellence.
 
• The selection process for the award involves a committee that evaluates the performance of the athletes over the previous four years.
 
• In addition to the Arjuna Award, the Government of India also presents other prestigious awards like the **Dronacharya Award and the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award **for sporting excellence.
